name: kitchen-squad-orchestrator
description: Multi-agent kitchen squad orchestrator coordinating culinary substitution and allergen/nutrition specialists.

skills.description: Evaluates chemical, microbial, and textural feasibility of recipe ingredient modifications.
Detects FDA Big 9 allergen risks and computes macronutrient shifts.

injected_failure_case_mapping.rationale: Rather than terminating as 'failed', the task should pause at 'input-required' to prompt the user to manually confirm their allergen list or accept an unverified allergen caveat.

a2a_task_lifecycle_mapping.a2a_vs_rest_value: A2A provides standard state machine lifecycles (pausing at input-required for human-in-the-loop clarification without dropping state) and standardized AgentCard capability discovery, whereas plain REST treats everything as a brittle synchronous request/response that hard-fails on 500.
